body:

# PLUGIN IS CURRENTLY ARCHIVED AND NOT BEING WORKED ON
New and rewritten version of the most used smp plugin lifesteal

This plugin features all normal lifesteal functions but with customizable/togglable options to make it more interesting!!

this plugin adds custom recipes and items for them for the following items below
- Heart (Gives the user 1 heart)
- Dense heart (Gives the user 8 hearts)
- Revive Beacon (revives a dead player)
- All Knowing Book (unlocks all custom recipes)

/bls - a Settings gui to change/toggle your prefered settings all you like

1. death drop - when on players drop hearts on death, when off when killed by a player the heart is instantly consumed

2. Mob Deaths - When a player is killed by a mob if set to true then a heart will drop if false then a heart won't drop on death

3. Full Death - When a player runs out of hearts if true then they will be banned off the server until they are brought back with a revive beacon, if false then they will just be put into spectator mode and they cannot fly through blocks

4. Minimal effects - When false all extra particle effects created by the plugin will not happen to help reduce player/server lag, when on then all particles from the plugin will happen (When on This will Barely change anything it is very very lightweight)

5. Heart glow - When true when a players heart is on the ground it will glow red until picked up, if false then the item will not glow at all

6. Beacon Revive - when true dead players can be revived with that item, when false then once a player dies they are permenantly stuck in Specator/Banned (Depends on what you have 3 Set to)

7. Book recipes - When true then players must unlock the recipes for custom items through the all knowing book, if false then all players are given the recipe when they join the server

# (Max Hearts)
When left clicked the amount of max hearts a player can have in increased by 1
when right clicked the amount of hearts a player can have is decreased by 1
If you Shift while doing one of these then the number is changed by 5 instead of 1

# Necro Challenge (Can Be Disabled)
When left clicked the amount of time/seconds the revive ritual happens will increase by one
When right clicked the amount of time/seconds the revive ritual happens will decreased by one
If you Shift while doing one of these then the number is changed by 5 instead of 1

to Save you Changes click on the lime wool named "Save & Close" and you changes are sazved and instantly applied
